question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

12, 14, 16, 13, 15, 14, 16, 10, 16, 12

The mode of the data is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a given dataset.

By visually scanning the given marks (12, 14, 16, 13, 15, 14, 16, 10, 16, 12), we can count their occurrences.

The mark 16 appears 3 times, while all other marks appear 1 or 2 times.

Since 16 has the highest frequency, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks scored by 10 students: 12, 14, 16, 13, 15, 14, 16, 10, 16, 12

**Method Used:**

Mode is the observation that has the maximum frequency in a given set of data.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arrange the given data in ascending order to easily group and count the marks.

⇒ Ordered data: 10, 12, 12, 13, 14, 14, 15, 16, 16, 16

⇒ Mark 10 → Frequency = 1

⇒ Mark 12 → Frequency = 2

⇒ Mark 13 → Frequency = 1

⇒ Mark 14 → Frequency = 2

⇒ Mark 15 → Frequency = 1

⇒ Mark 16 → Frequency = 3

⇒ Comparing the frequencies, the mark 16 has the highest frequency of 3.

⇒ Therefore, the mode of the given data is 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The mean is the arithmetic average of a data set, calculated by dividing the sum of all observations by the total number of observations.

Median

The median is the middlemost value of a sorted data set. For an even number of observations (n), it is the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

Empirical Relationship

For moderately skewed distributions, the mean, median, and mode are connected by the empirical formula: Mode ≈ 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
